separation.policy: random42 and random122 are different random partitions of the same 4,200-molecule Lipophilicity table; no per-molecule pairing or pooled metric is computed across them.

molecule_handling.invalid_smiles_policy: recorded with parse_ok=False and NaN descriptors; never dropped silently, and never included in a pairwise prediction comparison
molecule_handling.multi_component_policy: kept as one disconnected molecular graph (no salt stripping, no fragment selection); rooted balls stay inside one component; descriptors sum over the whole record
molecule_handling.empty_scaffold_policy: acyclic molecules have an empty Bemis-Murcko scaffold; the canonical isomeric-free SMILES is used as the scaffold key and scaffold_fallback_used=True is recorded
